title: 利润指引收窄：回购却加到200亿，通用汽车盘前为何走弱
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We have to start with that by back. It's a monster. Can you just break down for us how you come up with $20 billion?
segments.zh: 我们得从回购说起。规模巨大。能解释一下你们怎么定下200亿美元的吗？

segments.en: And what goes into make it a decision like that?
segments.zh: 这个决策是怎么做出的？

segments.en: Yeah, well, good morning, Jonathan. Thanks for having us today.
segments.zh: 好的，早上好，乔纳森。感谢邀请。

segments.en: When you look at the last several years, I think the one story and data point that you got to think about with General Motors is free cash flow generation.
segments.zh: 回顾过去几年，通用汽车的关键故事和数据点就是自由现金流生成。

segments.en: And cash flow has been incredibly strong, as you know, for the last several years.
segments.zh: 如你所知，过去几年现金流非常强劲。

segments.en: We've repurchased an average of about $7.5 billion.
segments.zh: 我们平均回购了约75亿美元。

segments.en: This is after we invest 10 to $12 billion in the company, because we got to keep that future portfolio strong.
segments.zh: 这是在我们向公司投入100到120亿美元之后，因为我们必须保持未来产品组合强劲。

segments.en: We got to keep our balance sheet strong. And then with free cash flow, we have an opportunity to return it back to shareholders.
segments.zh: 我们必须保持资产负债表强劲。然后利用自由现金流回报股东。

segments.en: Over the last four years, about $7.5 billion a year, we've lowered our fully diluted share count by 37%.
segments.zh: 过去四年，每年约75亿美元，我们将完全稀释后的股份数减少了37%。

segments.en: Since 2023, we just completed our recent $6.3 billion authorization that was given by the board earlier this year.
segments.zh: 自2023年以来，我们刚刚完成了董事会今年早些时候批准的63亿美元授权。

segments.en: I think that was slightly ahead of expectations that the street had for this year.
segments.zh: 我认为这略高于市场对今年的预期。

segments.en: And what the board has said is we're committed to continuing to drive shareholder value this way.
segments.zh: 董事会表示，我们致力于继续以此方式提升股东价值。

segments.en: When you look at all the progress we've made, we still have a very low PE multiple on forward earnings, our free cash flow yield per share is double digit returns.
segments.zh: 纵观我们取得的进展，前瞻盈利的市盈率仍然很低，每股自由现金流收益率达到两位数回报。

segments.en: And we think that this is a great way to return capital to shareholders and drive shareholder value.
segments.zh: 我们认为这是向股东返还资本并提升股东价值的绝佳方式。

segments.en: The upper end of the guide was a little bit softer than expected.
Paula, maybe people have focused on that this morning. Can we build on some of that?
segments.zh: Paula，今早人们可能关注了这一点。我们能就此展开谈谈吗？
